data.exact_reserve_text:
Prior years' development
The level of improvement on closed year reserves on Syndicate 308 is lower than in previous years, which have enjoyed releases as a result of continued positive run-off of a long term Italian Credit binder on the 2006 and 2007 years of account. In addition the 2015 calendar year saw number of late incurred claims developments on the Credit class.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Continued positive run-off of a long term Italian Credit binder which produced releases in prior years (2006 and 2007 years of account).

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 (Life) showed lower improvement on closed-year reserves in 2015 than in prior years. Historically the syndicate benefited from positive run-off on a longterm Italian Credit binder (2006/2007 years) which produced releases; in 2015 there were a number of late-incurred claim developments on the Credit class that reduced the level of prioryear improvement. The syndicate produced a small loss on a UK GAAP basis for the 2015 calendar year and the long-term business provision increased in 2015 compared with 2014.

data.data_quality_notes: Extraction uncertainty: Syndicate 308 is a life syndicate and the report presents 'long-term business provision' rather than a simple 'claims outstanding' line. The document's numbers for long-term business provision and prior-year reserve movements are presented in different notes and narrative paragraphs; an explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure could not be located. Opening reserve used is the opening long-term business provision (2014 comparative) found in the life/other UK life business section (interpreted as gross reserve for long-term business). Prior-year development (gross) was not unambiguously stated; narrative describes 'lower improvement' and references to releases from the 2006/2007 Italian Credit binder and late incurred Credit-class claims in 2015 but no single gross PYD number. Gross premium totals differ in different tables (segmental direct-insurance breakdown vs top-line); I used the gross premium shown in the long-term technical account (note) for total gross premiums written and used the direct-insurance segmental breakdown where available. All monetary values are millions GBP. Confidence scores are reduced where numbers were inferred from life-provision lines rather than an explicit 'Gross claims outstanding' liability line.
